title: Map vs Plan Mode: Which one to use? #flightsim #aviation #pilot
description:
Master your flight simulator navigation with this guide to Map and Plan modes. Learn how to switch between real-time traffic avoidance and leg-by-leg flight plan reviews using your cockpit avionics.

This breakdown simplifies the flight computer interface so you can execute turns and manage your route with precision. Perfect for pilots looking to improve their instrument flying skills.
